name: Twin
summary: No-code AI agent builder whose agents browse the web, connect apps and run on schedules or webhooks.
description: Describe a job in natural language and Twin builds an agent that scrapes sites, drives web apps with no API, enriches data, generates decks/images/video and reaches out over email, SMS, WhatsApp and LinkedIn. Agents run on schedules or webhooks and write back to 5,000+ connected apps; the Agents library holds community-built templates.
contains: no-code AI agent builder with browser automation for sites without APIs
5,000+ connected apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Sheets, calendars …)
triggers: schedules and webhooks; self-healing runs
agent template library plus use-case pages (lead gen, real estate, e-commerce …)
pricing: Plus $29, Pro $149, Store from $399 per month; 7-day free trial
public docs and API reference at docs.twin.so
